Available books: SELECT bookID AS "Book ID",title AS "Book Title",copy_number AS "Copy Number",availability_status AS "Status" FROM available_books ORDER BY title,copy_number
Outstanding fines: SELECT fineID AS "Fine ID",memberID AS "Member ID",Fname AS "First Name",Lname AS "Last Name",amount AS "Fine Amount",paid_status AS "Payment Status",fine_due_date AS "Due Date" FROM outstanding_fines ORDER BY fine_due_date
Borrowed books: SELECT bookID AS "Book ID",title AS "Book Title",borrow_date AS "Borrow Date",due_date AS "Due Date" FROM borrowed_books ORDER BY borrow_date
Books and authors: SELECT b.title AS "Book Title",a.Fname AS "Author First Name",a.Lname AS "Author Last Name" FROM books b,writes w,author a WHERE b.bookID=w.bookID AND w.authorID=a.authorID ORDER BY b.title
Borrowing history: SELECT m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name",b.title AS "Book Title",br.borrow_date AS "Borrow Date",br.due_date AS "Due Date",br.return_date AS "Return Date" FROM members_3nf m,borrows br,books b WHERE m.memberID=br.memberID AND br.bookID=b.bookID ORDER BY br.borrow_date DESC
Copies per book: SELECT b.title AS "Book Title",COUNT(bc.copy_number) AS "Total Copies" FROM books b LEFT JOIN book_copy bc ON b.bookID=bc.bookID GROUP BY b.bookID,b.title ORDER BY "Total Copies" DESC
Members with reservations: SELECT DISTINCT m.memberID AS "Member ID",m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name",b.title AS "Reserved Book" FROM members_3nf m,reserves r,books b WHERE m.memberID=r.memberID AND r.bookID=b.bookID ORDER BY "Last Name","First Name"
Total unpaid fines: SELECT m.memberID AS "Member ID",m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name",SUM(f.amount) AS "Total Unpaid" FROM members_3nf m,fine f WHERE m.memberID=f.memberID AND f.paid_status='Unpaid' GROUP BY m.memberID,m.Fname,m.Lname ORDER BY "Total Unpaid" DESC
Members who borrowed (EXISTS):
SELECT m.memberID AS "Member ID",m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name"
FROM members_3nf m
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM borrows br WHERE br.memberID=m.memberID)
ORDER BY m.Lname,m.Fname
Borrowed or reserved (UNION):
SELECT m.memberID AS "Member ID",m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name"
FROM members_3nf m,borrows br WHERE m.memberID=br.memberID
UNION
SELECT m.memberID AS "Member ID",m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name"
FROM members_3nf m,reserves r WHERE m.memberID=r.memberID
ORDER BY "Last Name","First Name"
Borrowed but never reserved (MINUS):
SELECT m.memberID AS "Member ID",m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name"
FROM members_3nf m,borrows br WHERE m.memberID=br.memberID
MINUS
SELECT m.memberID AS "Member ID",m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name"
FROM members_3nf m,reserves r WHERE m.memberID=r.memberID
ORDER BY "Last Name","First Name"
Frequently borrowed books:
SELECT b.title AS "Book Title",COUNT(*) AS "Total Borrowings"
FROM books b,borrows br
WHERE b.bookID=br.bookID
GROUP BY b.bookID,b.title
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY "Total Borrowings" DESC,b.title
Unpaid fine statistics:
SELECT m.memberID AS "Member ID",m.Fname AS "First Name",m.Lname AS "Last Name",
COUNT(*) AS "Unpaid Fine Count",SUM(f.amount) AS "Total Unpaid",
ROUND(AVG(f.amount),2) AS "Average Fine",MAX(f.amount) AS "Largest Fine",MIN(f.amount) AS "Smallest Fine"
FROM members_3nf m,fine f
WHERE m.memberID=f.memberID AND f.paid_status='Unpaid'
GROUP BY m.memberID,m.Fname,m.Lname
ORDER BY "Total Unpaid" DESC
